SELECT Fname
FROM Student
JOIN Has_Pet ON Student.StuID = Has_Pet.StuID
JOIN Pets ON Has_Pet.PetID = Pets.PetID
WHERE PetType IN ('cat','dog')
GROUP BY Student.StuID, Fname
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PetType) = 2;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT Fname
FROM Student
JOIN Has_Pet ON Student.StuID = Has_Pet.StuID
JOIN Pets ON Has_Pet.PetID = Pets.PetID
WHERE PetType IN ('cat','dog')
GROUP BY Student.StuID, Fname
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PetType) = 2;
